as_told.title: Ultrasound and random number generator testing of psionic subjects

plain: A member of Jake Barber's team has recently made a breakthrough with a non-invasive ultrasound system that, Barber says, can pass through the skull and target parts of the brain to help a person "transition out of intellect and into your intuition." Barber is a helicopter pilot who says he once flew a UFO retrieval mission, and he describes the work to Michels as something his own group is doing. In a second account he passes on what a named colleague told him: subjects are also tested with random number generators, and the work is done with a partner organisation. If it is true, it would mean a device can deliberately switch on intuitive states of mind.
